requirement.description: The external() function fails when processing bytes objects due to AttributeError: 'bytes' object has no attribute 'items'. This happens in the test_encoding tests when encoding non-UTF-8 encodings.
requirement.contract: The external() function should properly handle bytes objects in comparison operations without attempting to call .items() method on bytes objects. The function should correctly compare bytes values and handle encoding/decoding appropriately.

requirement.description: The UUID storage implementation raises KeyError: 'uuid' when trying to access storage configuration. This occurs in various UUID-related tests that expect the uuid storage to be available.
requirement.contract: The UUID storage should be properly initialized and accessible in the global state's storage registry. The storage lookup mechanism should correctly handle UUID-based external files and prevent KeyError exceptions when accessing storage configurations.

requirement.description: The external() function doesn't properly handle bytes comparison in __eq__ method. The comparison logic incorrectly assumes all objects are dictionaries or have certain methods like .items().
requirement.contract: The external() function's __eq__ method should handle bytes objects properly by comparing their raw values instead of trying to call .items() on them. It should support proper bytes-to-bytes and bytes-to-string comparisons.
